sources.title: Commission selects 46 new Strategic Projects to bolster the EU's supply of critical raw materials
evidence: the European Commission today announced that it has selected 46 new Strategic Projects across 16 Member States.
They were selected from 102 applications received in the call for applications that concluded earlier this year.
eight are on extraction, 11 on processing, and 19 are recycling projects

sources.title: European Commission picks 46 new strategic critical mineral projects
evidence: The European Commission has chosen 46 strategic raw material projects to benefit from faster permitting
The 46 new projects are expected to require around €21.1 billion ($23.7 billion) in capital investment
Arctial’s planned aluminium smelter in Finland and the Viscaria copper project in Sweden
Strategic projects do not automatically receive EU funding.

sources.title: Germany to release 15 million barrels from oil reserves
evidence: Germany will release up to 15 million barrels of oil and petroleum products, the economy ministry said Friday
as part of a Group of Seven agreement to release 100 million barrels of diesel and crude oil from emergency reserves.
diesel and heating oil will be released first, with crude oil to follow.
